package generatedtest

import (
	"context"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/DiLRandI/confgen/config"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestGeneratedConsumer(t *testing.T) {
	env := config.Env(config.WithLookupEnv(func(key string) (string, bool) {
		values := map[string]string{"PASSWORD": "sentinel", "CHECK_INTEGER": "7", "CHECK_PRIVATE": "ignored"}
		v, ok := values[key]
		return v, ok
	}))
	file := config.Reader("file", strings.NewReader(`{"integer":3}`), config.FormatJSON)
	cfg, err := Load(file, env)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, 7, cfg.Integer, "unexpected configuration")
	require.Equal(t, "hello", cfg.Text, "unexpected configuration")
	require.False(t, cfg.Boolean, "unexpected configuration")
	require.Equal(t, ^uint64(0), cfg.Huge, "unexpected configuration")
	require.Equal(t, int64(-9223372036854775808), cfg.Signed, "unexpected configuration")
	require.Equal(t, 90*time.Minute, cfg.Timeout, "unexpected configuration")
	require.Equal(t, "local", cfg.Nested.Endpoint, "unexpected configuration")
	require.Equal(t, "private", cfg.Private, "unexpected configuration")
	require.Equal(t, "sentinel", cfg.Password, "unexpected configuration")
	require.Equal(t, 1, len(cfg.Backends), "unexpected configuration")
	require.Equal(t, 80, cfg.Backends[0].Port, "unexpected configuration")
	require.True(t, cfg.Backends[0].Options.TLS, "unexpected configuration")
	require.Equal(t, "first", cfg.Labels["a"], "unexpected configuration")
	reversed, err := Load(env, file)
	require.NoError(t, err, "reversed load: %v", err)
	require.Equal(t, 3, reversed.Integer, "reversed load: %v", err)
	cfg.Backends[0].Name = "changed"
	cfg.Labels["a"] = "changed"
	again := MustLoad(env)
	require.Equal(t, "primary", again.Backends[0].Name, "mutable defaults shared across loads")
	require.Equal(t, "first", again.Labels["a"], "mutable defaults shared across loads")
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	cancel()
	{
		got, err := LoadContext(ctx, env)
		require.Nil(t, got, "cancellation not preserved")
		require.ErrorIs(t, err, context.Canceled, "cancellation not preserved")
	}
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	for range 10 {
		wg.Go(func() {
			_, err := Load(file, env)
			assert.NoError(t, err)
		})
	}
	wg.Wait()
}

func TestMustLoadPanics(t *testing.T) {
	require.Panics(t, func() { MustLoad() })
}
